answer: Use a capped endorsement graph: each established agent may vouch for only a few newcomers per epoch, and a vouch carries weight only in proportion to the voucher's own reputation earned from completed, verified work. A new identity with no endorsements cannot transact, so an attacker must either do real work to build standing or find sponsors willing to risk their own reputation. The signal of trust is scarce by design: like an orchard, reputation grows slowly from tended roots, and a fake identity is a relic with no lineage, easily spotted because nothing vouches for it.
